comments.content: `reasoning::resolve` here uses the original global `provider` and `cfg.model` (via `model_for_reasoning`), not the override's resolved values. When `model_override` is `Some(id)`, the actual HTTP request goes to the override's model/protocol (e.g., glm-4.6 on OpenAI), but the reasoning-effort wire is still computed against the global active model/protocol (e.g., deepseek-v4-flash). This silently drops reasoning control for the override model: e.g., global=deepseek (→ `ReasoningWire::None` as unknown family) + override=glm-4.6 → no `reasoning_effort` field is sent even when the user set Medium. Pass the resolved model and provider instead.

保留卡（kept）分支只回写 `canvas_pos`，未同步 `node.model`。在「仅改 model 不改标题/备注/标签」的场景下，指纹命中保留现有任务 id，但草稿里的新 model 值被静默丢弃——用户改 model 后整画布保存会看起来没生效（实际生效必须改 title 触整卡重建）。建议参照 `canvas_pos` 一并赋值 `t.model = node.model.clone();`（为空允许清空），并补一条「同内容仅 model 变更被回写」的单测覆盖保留路径。

文件解析与 `task_patch` 白名单契约不一致：`task_patch` 显式拒绝 `model: ""`（见 db/tasks.rs apply_task_patch 新增分支），但 `parse_workflow_file` 把 `model` 原样透传，`.wflow.json` 写 `"model": ""` 会落入 DB 形成空串。建议在 `parse_workflow_file` 对 `n.model` 做去空白 + 空串归一化为 `None`（和 `note` 处理方式对齐），或在 `workflow_save_locked` 入参校验时再加一次 `model` 非空守卫（与 `check_len` 同样的早期拒绝风格），避免文件导入绕过白名单。

comments.content: The `model` arm rejects an all-whitespace string but does not strip surrounding whitespace before storing. Same pattern is used for `workflowId`/`dependsOn`, so this is consistent project-wide. If you want strictness at write-time rather than just validation, trim `task.model` after `set_from`. Not blocking.

The model entry shape `Array<{ id: string; label: string }>` is duplicated across `WorkflowPage.tsx` (the `models` useState and the `modelsByProvider` mapping) and `TaskNode.tsx` (the `TaskNodeData.models` field). Consider extracting a `ModelEntry` type alias into `src/types.ts` so the contract is defined once and reused; this also documents the wire shape between the Rust `modelsByProvider` payload and the React tree.

comments.content: Silent `.catch(() => {})` is inconsistent with the established error-handling pattern in this file (e.g., the sibling `list_workflows` effect uses `handleCommandError(e, "读取工作流列表", { silent: true })`). If `bot_get_config` regresses (no `modelsByProvider`, or schema change), the model dropdown will silently appear empty with no signal to the user/developer. Use `handleCommandError` for parity, or at minimum log the error.

The inline `(taskId, model) => onUpdate(...)` closure is inconsistent with every other handler in this file (`toggleDone`, `commitTitle`, `toggleSubtask`) which are defined as `useCallback([])` at the top and read `propsRef.current.onUpdate` to dodge stale-closure. As written, `onModelChange` captures the `onUpdate` prop at the moment the `useMemo` last ran, so if the parent passes a new `onUpdate` reference without the memo's deps changing, the node still calls the stale one. Either define it as a stable `useCallback` (reading `propsRef.current.onUpdate` like the others), or add `onUpdate` to the memo deps.

The inline `Array<{ id: string; label: string }>` shape is repeated three times in this useEffect (state initializer + openai + anthropic). Promoting it to a single named alias (or sharing the backend's `ModelEntry` type if one exists) avoids drift if the model entry gains fields like `provider`/`deprecated`.

Stale-model state/UI inconsistency: when task.model is set to an id no longer present in data.models (e.g., the library entry was removed or disabled after the task was saved), the controlled select falls back to displaying "跟随全局模型" (the first option) while task.model still holds the stale value. Until the user manually re-selects, the card UI misrepresents the actual model used at execution time — the only safety net is the backend's loud-error path. Consider either always rendering a fallback option that reflects task.model when it isn't in the list, or reconciling stale values to undefined upstream when models are loaded.

comments.content: The new `model` patch arm is added but no test covers it. Following the established pattern in `task_patch_orchestration_fields_set_and_null_clears` (covers assignee/budget/result) and the `model` empty-string rejection at tasks.rs:839, a parallel test verifying (a) setting a valid model id, (b) `null` clears it, and (c) whitespace-only rejection would lock the wire contract and prevent regressions like the future 'model' patch arm silently accepting JSON-typed wrong values or losing the empty-rejection check.

The `model_by_id.clone()` inside the `spawn_node` closure deep-clones the entire HashMap on every node spawn. For large workflows this becomes O(n²) (n spawned nodes × n map entries). Wrap the map in `Arc<HashMap<...>>` once in `workflow_run` and clone the `Arc` (cheap refcount bump) instead — matches the `running: Arc<Mutex<HashSet<String>>>` pattern already used right next to it for the same reason.

comments.content:
The save() payload omits `model` from the `WorkflowNodeDraft` mapping, so clicking 保存 wipes out the model that was just set on the node via the dropdown. Concretely:

1. User picks "GLM-4" on a card → `onModelChange` → `task_patch` writes `model="glm"` to DB
2. User clicks 保存 → `workflow_save` runs with `n.model === undefined`, backend `WorkflowNodeDraft.model` defaults to `None`, `upsert_tasks` overwrites `model = NULL`
3. Next page reload / re-open shows the model as unset

The spec explicitly calls out `WorkflowNodeDraft.model` as one of the four sync points ("Task.model 四同步点：TS/Rust/DB 列（幂等 ALTER）/task_patch 白名单（拒空串）") and says the save/draft should carry `model` ("保存/文件透传：WorkflowNodeDraft.model + .wflow.json 节点可选 model 字段"). Two issues conspire to drop the field:
- `CanvasNode` in `src/components/WorkflowCanvas/graph.ts` has no `model` member, so `n.model` is always undefined in `save()`
- `draftFromTasks` (`graph.ts:104`) doesn't pick `model` from the loaded `Task`, so reopening a workflow also loses it from the canvas

Suggested fix: add `model?: string` to `CanvasNode`, include it in `draftFromTasks`'s Pick + mapping, have `save()` forward `model: n.model ?? null`, and have `onModelChange` also `setNodes((prev) => prev.map(...))` to keep canvas in sync (mirroring the `commitTitle` pattern that updates both canvas and tasks). Without this, every 保存 is a destructive operation on the just-set model.

`onModelChange` only calls `onUpdate` (which patches `Task.model` on the global tasks list) but never `setNodes`. Other handlers in this component follow the 「commitTitle × updateCanvas + updateTask」 two-track contract so the canvas never goes stale. Here, the canvas `nodes[i].model` stays `undefined` for the lifetime of the canvas session — even if you fix the save payload above, the canvas will only ever rehydrate `model` via `draftFromTasks` on next open. While a card is mounted, any code path that reads `n.model` on the canvas (e.g. the save payload itself, future snapshot/dirty diffs) sees `undefined`. Mirror the `commitTitle` pattern: `setNodes((prev) => prev.map((m) => (m.taskId === taskId ? { ...m, model } : m)))` before/alongside the `onUpdate` call.

The model dropdown in `TaskNode.tsx` (`{data.models.length > 0 && <select ...>}`) is hidden whenever the in-memory `models` list is empty, even on cards that already have a `task.model` set. Two concrete breakages:
1. While `bot_get_config` is still in flight on initial mount, every saved card with a model shows nothing — user has no way to inspect or change it until the invoke resolves.
2. If the user removes all models from 设置→模型设置 after a card has a model assigned, reopening the workflow (or adding new cards) shows no dropdown — there's then no path to clear the stale `model` via the UI (only `task_patch` with `model: null` from somewhere else could clear it).

Show the dropdown unconditionally when `task !== undefined` and a model is set (or always when `task !== undefined`); the option list naturally degrades to just "跟随全局模型" if `models` is empty.

            title="本卡执行用大模型（不选 = 跟随全局）"
            className="mx-1 mt-1 block w-[calc(100%-0.5rem)] rounded-[var(--r-sm)] bg-transparent px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] text-[var(--t3)] nm-inset"
            value={task.model ?? ""}

              <option key={m.id} value={m.id}>
                {m.label}

            ))}

comments.content:
The workflow canvas dropdown shows disabled models in the library, but the chat panel (`ChatPanel.tsx:337-348`) filters by `m.enabled !== false` and by `disabledVendors` / `verifiedVendors`. So a user can pick a disabled model here → `task_patch` happily persists it → at execution time `resolve_model_override` returns `Err("模型条目「...」已停用：...")`. The selection model is correct *for chat* but not for the workflow canvas, so the user sees a confusing failure mode. Two options, pick one: either
(a) align with ChatPanel and filter `enabled !== false` (and arguably `disabledVendors` / `verifiedVendors` if exposed via `bot_get_config` view) before mapping to `setModels`, or
(b) keep the dropdown permissive but add a `⚠ 已停用` suffix in the `<option>` text so the user sees the disabled state at selection time.
Option (a) matches the chat panel exactly; option (b) preserves the spec wording "模型库全条目". Either way, the silent-on-select / loud-on-execute mismatch is the real bug.
